newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Lisbon bourse trade interrupted due comms problems.
newsitem.headline: Lisbon bourse trade interrupted due comms problems.

text.p: Trade on Lisbon bourse was interrupted due to technical problems which prevented the share market from opening at 1230 GMT, a bourse spokesman said.
He said trade was expected to resume at 1300 GMT.
A delayed pre-opening session took place from 1200 to 1230 GMT after the Tradis trading system experienced computer problems.
